title: styling item with multiple values in a field
body:
Say I have index item with this structure:

```json
   {
      "name": "alvinsee",
      "ra_list": [
         "Comparative Law",
         "Contract Law",
         "Equity & Trusts",
         "Unjust Enrichment & Restitution",
         "Tort Law",
         "Property Law",
         "Animal Law"
      ]
   }
```

I realise the output of `{{ra_list}}` is a comma separated output. How can I style this into `<li>` or  `<div>`

comments.body:
Hey @dfcn84, glad that you solved this. Could you explain what the problem was and how you solved it, for future reference? 

Thanks!
